""" Acceptance tests for issue #5: TOC ids for non-English (Hindi, Russian) headings. """ import os import unittest import markdown from markdown.test_tools import TestCase from markdown.extensions.toc import TocExtension, slugify, slugify_unicode DOCS_PATH = os.path.join( os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), 'docs', 'extensions', 'toc.md' ) def read_docs(): with open(DOCS_PATH, encoding='utf-8') as f: return f.read() class TestSlugifyUnicodeCombiningMarks(TestCase): """FR-001: slugify_unicode keeps Mn/Mc characters.""" def test_ac_fr_001_01_hindi_heading_keeps_vowel_signs_and_virama(self): self.assertMarkdownRenders( '# नमस्ते दुनिया', '

नमस्ते दुनिया

', extensions=[TocExtension(slugify=slugify_unicode)] ) def test_ac_fr_001_02_direct_call_hindi_combining_marks(self): self.assertEqual(slugify_unicode('हिन्दी', '-'), 'हिन्दी') def test_ac_fr_001_03_russian_heading_unchanged(self): self.assertMarkdownRenders( '# Привет мир', '

Привет мир

', extensions=[TocExtension(slugify=slugify_unicode)] ) def test_ac_fr_001_04_punctuation_removed_japanese_unchanged(self): self.assertEqual(slugify_unicode('Unicode ヘッダー!?', '-'), 'unicode-ヘッダー') def test_ac_fr_001_04_permalink_with_unicode_in_id_still_passes(self): self.assertMarkdownRenders( '# Unicode ヘッダー', '

' 'Unicode ヘッダー' '¶' '

', extensions=[TocExtension(permalink=True, slugify=slugify_unicode)] ) def test_ac_fr_001_04_permalink_with_unicode_title_still_passes(self): self.assertMarkdownRenders( '# Unicode ヘッダー', '

' 'Unicode ヘッダー' '¶' '

', extensions=[TocExtension(permalink=True, permalink_title="パーマリンク", slugify=slugify_unicode)] ) def test_ac_fr_001_05_default_slugify_extended_latin(self): self.assertEqual(slugify('Théâtre', '-'), 'theatre') def test_ac_fr_001_05_default_slugify_cyrillic_empty(self): self.assertEqual(slugify('Привет мир', '-'), '') def test_ac_fr_001_05_permalink_with_extended_latin_in_id_still_passes(self): self.assertMarkdownRenders( '# Théâtre', '

' 'Théâtre' '¶' '

', extensions=[TocExtension(permalink=True)] ) class TestSlugifyUnicodeDocs(unittest.TestCase): """FR-002: docs contain a concrete non-Latin slugify_unicode example.""" EXPECTED_HTML = '

Привет мир

' def test_ac_fr_002_01_docs_show_configuration(self): text = read_docs() self.assertIn('TocExtension(slugify=slugify_unicode)', text) self.assertIn('from markdown.extensions.toc import TocExtension, slugify_unicode', text) def test_ac_fr_002_02_docs_show_cyrillic_heading_and_id(self): text = read_docs() self.assertIn('# Привет мир', text) self.assertIn(self.EXPECTED_HTML, text) def test_ac_fr_002_03_documented_output_matches_actual(self): result = markdown.markdown( '# Привет мир', extensions=[TocExtension(slugify=slugify_unicode)] ) self.assertEqual(result, self.EXPECTED_HTML) def test_ac_fr_002_04_default_documented_unchanged(self): self.assertIn('Default: `markdown.extensions.toc.slugify`', read_docs()) if __name__ == '__main__': unittest.main()
